newsitem.title: CHINA: Hopewell's China power venture begins operation.
newsitem.headline: Hopewell's China power venture begins operation.

text.p: China's biggest coal-fired power plant, a joint venture involving Hong Kong's Hopewell Holdings Ltd, has begun operation, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.

The Shajiao Number Three power plant in the southern province of Guangdong was expected to generate more than 10.8 billion kilowatt-hours of electricity each year, Xinhua said. It involved foreign investments of $1.2 billion.
Ownership of the power plant, a joint venture between the Guangdong Provincial Electricity Administration and Hopewell, would be transferred to Guangdong in 20 years, the agency said.
